login.title: Iniciar sesión
login.subtitle: Inicia sesión para empezar
login.passwordRequired: Se requiere un método de acceso
login.invalidPassword: Error al iniciar sesión. Inténtalo de nuevo.
login.connectionFailed: No se pudo conectar al servicio de autenticación. Inténtalo de nuevo.
login.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please contact an administrator.
login.loadFailed: Couldn't load the sign-in options. Reload the page to try again.
login.setupNotice: This site has no admin yet. The server log has a one-time setup code.

notRegistered.title: No estás registrado
notRegistered.description: Has iniciado sesión con Steam, pero aún no estás en la lista de jugadores. Pide a un admin que te añada. Hasta entonces, solo puedes ver jugadores y clasificaciones.
notRegistered.signInFirst: Inicia sesión con Steam para continuar. Si aún no estás en la lista de jugadores, verás un mensaje pidiéndote que contactes con tu admin.

impersonation.bannerBody: Eres un administrador viendo el sitio como otro jugador. Las acciones que realices se harán en su nombre.
impersonation.stopped: De vuelta en tu propia cuenta
impersonation.failed: No se pudo cambiar a ese jugador
impersonation.cannotImpersonateAdmin: No se puede suplantar a un administrador

connectSteam.title: Conecta tu cuenta de Steam
connectSteam.bodyIntro: Ya casi está listo. Para usar la plataforma del torneo con esta cuenta (por ejemplo, después de iniciar sesión con Discord o GitHub), necesitas vincular un perfil de Steam.
connectSteam.bodyRequirement: Vincular Steam permite que el sistema te reconozca como jugador y es necesario para iniciar sesión con proveedores que no sean Steam.

adminSetup.title: Set up Auto Tournament
adminSetup.codeIntro: Enter the setup code from the server log. It starts with [SETUP].
adminSetup.accountIntro: Create the admin account you will sign in with.
adminSetup.badCode: That code is not valid or has expired. Restart the container for a new setup code, or run reset-admin again.
adminSetup.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
adminSetup.usernameHelp: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
adminSetup.passwordHelp: You choose how strong it is. A password manager can make one for you.
adminSetup.resetAccountHint: Enter an existing local admin username to set a new password (its two-step verification is removed), or a new username to create another admin.
adminSetup.after: Next you can turn on two-step verification, then set up how players sign in.
adminSetup.failed: Setup failed. Check the server log.

problem.username: Choose a username of 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
problem.too_long: The password can be at most 256 characters.

adminSetup.closedBody: This site already has an admin. If nobody can sign in, run reset-admin on the server.
adminSetup.totpSubtitle: Recommended: sign-in then also asks for a code from an authenticator app.

localAdmin.title: Admin login
localAdmin.subtitle: For local admin accounts. Players sign in on the main sign-in page.
localAdmin.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
localAdmin.off: Local admin login is turned off on this site.
localAdmin.totpHelp: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

totp.intro: Add this key to an authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Aegis and others), then enter the code it shows.
totp.wrongCode: That code is not right. Check the time on your phone and try again.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app

verify.title: Confirm email
verify.failed: This link does not work any more. Send a new one from your account page.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.ok: You won't get tournament emails any more. Turn them back on from your account page.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Two-step verification stays on if you use it.
resetPassword.mismatch: The new passwords are not the same
resetPassword.done: Password saved for {{username}}. Sign in with it now.
resetPassword.noToken: This link is missing its code. Open the link from the email again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your username or email. If the account has a confirmed email, we send a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If that account has a confirmed email, a link is on its way. It works for one hour.
forgotPassword.failed: Could not send the link. Try again.

firstSignIn.title: Choose your own password
firstSignIn.subtitle: Welcome, {{username}}. An admin made this account with a password they picked. Choose your own now.
firstSignIn.currentHelp: The one you just signed in with.
firstSignIn.mismatch: The new passwords are not the same
firstSignIn.emailSubtitle: So you can reset your password yourself if you forget it. We send a link to confirm it.
firstSignIn.totpSubtitle: Optional: a code from your phone at every sign-in, on top of your password.
